messages.subject: Cardinal imzML compatibility with MZmine
parts:
Hi all,

I am trying to use MZmine3 for annotation queries after processing with Cardinal.

I have tried to save imzML files with a number of ways/params with writeMSIData() and writeImzML(), but  they are all incompatible with MZmine3. I get the error: "I: Scans were detected as centroid but contain zero intensity values."

imzML files from METASPACE and SCiLS are successfully imported into MZmine3.

has anyone tried this and have suggestions? is there a way to compare the internal structured of imzML files?

thank you in advance!
